item.text: Requests are sent at any size up to the model's context window; sc-agent adds no byte cap.
item.title: Request sizing

item.text: sc-agent rejects any request body over 64 KiB before sending it.
item.title: Request cap

item.text: Delete the MAX_INPUT_BYTES check from the request builder so input is bounded only by the selected model's context.
item.title: Remove MAX_INPUT

item.text: Map sc-observability's RecordTooLarge error to the SINK.RECORD error code in sc-agent.
item.title: Size error mapping

cases.rationale: Handles a size error without imposing an input cap; silent on the rule.

item.text: Document how large a request can be in the decidr README.
item.title: Size docs

item.text: Add a 32,000-token guard: sc-agent truncates any prompt longer than 32,000 tokens before sending, whatever the model.
item.title: Token guard

cases.rationale: An own limit below model context conflicts.

item.text: Look up the result cache by request sha256 and model.
item.title: Cache key

item.text: Before sending, compare the request's token count with the selected model's context window and fail with CONTEXT.EXCEEDED only when it is larger.
item.title: Context check

cases.rationale: A check at exactly the model's context is not a limit beyond it.

item.text: When sc-observability rejects a log record as too large, sc-agent reports the sink error; the request itself is still sent.
item.title: Record sink size

cases.rationale: A log-record size error from sc-observability is not an sc-agent request input cap; no statement of the rule.
